entries.topic: Jewish day schools and supplementary schools

claims.text: AVI CHAI 2018-19 census: a little over 900 day schools, nearly 300,000 students, at least 37 states; ~87% of students in Orthodox schools, two-thirds in ultra-Orthodox; non-Orthodox schools enroll 35% of students outside NY and NJ.
Supplementary (Hebrew) school enrollment: ~280,000 (1987), 230,000+ (2006), ~141,000 (2020); 700+ schools closed 2006-2020; Chabad share of enrollment 4% to 10%.
Hearts and Minds (2014), Pomson, Wertheimer, Hacohen-Wolf, funded by AVI CHAI: 'Israel is rarely contested in day schools'; Israel serves as a unifying force.
Satmar: Joel Teitelbaum (b. 1887) rebuilt the community in Williamsburg and Kiryas Joel; Vayoel Moshe; literal reading of the Three Oaths makes a state built by human effort a sin.
JIMENA toolkit (Feb 2024): schools built when Jewish life was 'Ashkenormative'; Pew 2020: at least 10% of American Jews Sephardi, Mizrahi or mixed.

claims.text: 2025: Jewish Agency sent a record 2,050 summer shlichim to 190 North American camps, reaching 150,000+ campers, staff and community members.
May 2018 IfNotNow counselor training; Ramah national director Mitchell Cohen: 'First we teach a love for Israel. Then we teach the nuances and the conflict.'
'You Never Told Me' campaign (IfNotNow, 2018) asking camps, schools and youth groups to teach the occupation and Palestinian narratives; Liberation Syllabus.

claims.text: Sample itinerary: Tzfat, Golan with a mandatory geopolitics lecture, Western Wall, Yad Vashem and Mount Herzl, Masada, Bedouin village, Tel Aviv Independence Hall; groups may meet Israeli soldiers and young professionals.

Feldman (2011): Western Wall and Masada required; itineraries approved by Birthright's Jerusalem office; Chazan: 'emotionally overwhelming experience'; Gidi Mark: participants to tell campus critics 'I was there'; no provider had taken groups into a West Bank Palestinian town; Bronfman: 'Israel does its magic'.
28 Jun 2018: five participants walked off with IfNotNow and went to Hebron with Breaking the Silence; Birthright called the video misleading.
Thirteen walked off in summer 2018; Birthright rescinded return flights and said it 'will not tolerate any attempts to use this experience to promote ideological agendas'.

claims.text: JEI/GBAO, 800 Jewish voters, 28 Jun-1 Jul 2021: 25% agree Israel is an apartheid state (over a third under 40); 22% genocide (a third under 40); statements asked only of those who first said they were not hateful.
Pew Feb 2024: under 35, 52% call Israel's conduct of the war acceptable, 42% unacceptable; 68% acceptable among 50+.
JFNA survey (Mar 2025, released Feb 2026): 18-34: 35% Zionist, 32% anti- or non-Zionist, 76% support Israel as Jewish and democratic state, 57% emotionally attached; 75+: 88% attached.

AP-NORC 2026, 1,022 Jewish adults: about a quarter of religiously affiliated and about 4 in 10 unaffiliated say Israel committed genocide in Gaza; support for Israel less central to younger adults' identity.
